requirements: The authoritative provenance state is state/provenance.json.
provenance.aliases maps observed source names to canonical source names.
Canonicalize record sources before blocked/rejected filtering and priority comparison.
provenance.rejectedSources excludes canonical sources regardless of options.
provenance.sourcePriority is authoritative and is evaluated before any remaining option sourcePriority entries.
The result remains deterministic and does not mutate inputs.
